name: Donchian breakout 1d
label: 1d_40
hypothesis: Time-series momentum in crypto is documented at day-to-week horizons (Liu & Tsyvinski, RFS 2021): institutional metaorders execute with participation, creating return persistence that survives a wide stop and low turnover. A Donchian channel captures that persistence with causal rules, and at one bar per day the round-trip cost drops to ~0.018 R, so the edge does not have to be large to survive.
failure_modes: régimen de baja volatilidad prolongado: el canal no se rompe y el sistema no opera
gap de liquidación (2025-10-10): el stop se ejecuta muy por debajo del nivel
funding persistentemente positivo: sesgo contra los cortos, 3-5x las fees
